draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 121st-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 6th of 12 at TE. He went 118th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Mark Andrews. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (96th percentile). College production: 306 receiving yards in 2019, 8th of 12 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 31 career games and 7 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (9th percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-6 tight end who played: 36 receiving yards against a median of 252, below the norm.
